ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85% high-intensity (white) pixels to 15% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions covering the interior of both lobes; a central vertical black region at the peduncle junction; a continuous black border along the entire trailing edge; small focal black spots scattered across the white interior, specifically in the lower-left and right-central areas.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow U-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 135 degrees and moderate depth relative to the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the trailing edge; distinct larger notches on the far-left lobe tip and irregular jagged peaks on the far-right tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Overall convex curve from the median notch to the tips, ending in a sharp upward concavity at the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, low-intensity circular pixel clusters (focal spots) distributed across the white surface of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct, parallel dark linear streaks in the lower-left quadrant; one smaller, unaligned linear mark located superior to the parallel pair.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent rake marks on the left lobe; visible notch-like trauma on the upper-left trailing edge; irregular dark scarring cluster on the far right tip.
